_comment_: Claude Code Starter Kit — MCP server wiring. Step 07 of the finisher merges this into ~/.mcp.json without clobbering your existing entries.

lean-ctx._note_: Assumes lean-ctx binary is on PATH. Install instructions: see docs/INSTALL.md. If you installed via Homebrew tap, the tap name is set by the installer.

armory._note_: The kit vendors the Armory MCP server source at mcp-servers/armory/ and the finisher builds it during install.
